name: Gladiator

traits.name: Demonic Restoration
traits.text: If the glabrezu dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points some- where in the Abyss.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The glabrezu has Advantage on sav- ing throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The glabrezu makes two Pincer attacks and uses Pummel or Spellcasting.

actions.name: Pincer
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15) from one of two pincers.

actions.name: Pummel
actions.text: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature

actions.name: Grappled by the glabrezu
actions.text: Failure: 15 (3d6 + 5) Blud- geoning damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The glabrezu casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using In- telligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):

actions.text: Darkness, Detect Magic, Dispel Magic 1/Day Each: Confusion, Fly, Power Word Stun Gladiator Gladiator Medium or Small Humanoid, Neutral AC 16 Initiative +5 (15) HP 112 (15d8 + 45) Speed 30 ft. actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The gladiator makes three Spear attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Shield Bash.

actions.name: Spear

actions.name: Shield Bash

reactions.text: Trigger: The gladiator is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The gladiator adds 3 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss. Gnoll Gnoll Warrior
